tasks.short: Contact the client when the interval has passed.

steps.what: List clients whose contact interval has passed
Contact clients periodically about their financial status
Determine changes only from the client's own words
Sign the contact note
File the signed contact note
outputs: filed copy of signed contact note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CRM} lists a client only when the stored contact interval has passed since the last signed contact. The advisor makes the contact and determines any change in financial status from the client's own words. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not call or message the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contacts were remembered rather than tied to a stored interval.
tasks.enabler_now: Client identifier, contact interval, and last contact date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether anything the client said is a change.

ambition.what: Sign the contact note the day the stored interval has passed since the last signed contact.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the contact, not on the interval list.

reach.task: Confirm only the note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor makes the contact. A stored interval list does not call the client.

assumptions: Client identifier, contact interval, and last contact date are stored on the client record. The client record produces them. A client is listed only when the stored interval has passed since the last signed contact. A blank interval is not due. A blank last contact is not due. A blank status change is not written as a change.
Native configuration of the client record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor contacting clients about their financial status.

incremental.description: Refresh client identifier, contact interval, and last contact date when the client layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many contact intervals are blank. The high end assumes contact interval and last contact date are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check the summary, then send it.

steps.what: Assemble stored performance figures for the clients
Prepare for clients the investment performance reports
Interpret income projections and document summaries
Draft the summary so each figure traces

loop.purpose: Draft the client summary so every figure traces to a stored row.
loop.input: Stored performance rows, the advisor outline, and the advisor interpretation.
loop.output: A draft whose every figure and every claim restates one of those rows.
loop.check: Every number matches a stored row, and every claim is a restatement of that row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number or a claim has no row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot restate a variable set of performance figures in prose.

steps.what: Check each claim and figure against a stored row
Sign the client summary
Send only the signed client summary
outputs: filed copy of signed client summary v1

tasks.design: A job in {BI} assembles stored performance figures and does not draw the chart by hand. The advisor prepares the investment performance reports and interprets the income projections and document summaries before any draft. A bounded draft restates those rows and stops when a figure or a claim has no row. The advisor checks that restatement. A later job in {EMAIL} sends only the signed text. It does not produce a score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Summaries went out with figures that were not tied back to a row.
tasks.enabler_now: Figure identifier, amount, and source row identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The interpretation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides the summary is faithful.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the check, not on assembling rows.

reach.task: Read only the summary the advisor signed
reach.learn: Which figure had no source row

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] says most models in a published test ended a cash waterfall at the wrong figure. This design checks every figure against a source row.
The executive digest says dashboards replace drawing charts.

assumptions: Figure identifier, amount, and source row identifier are stored on the performance record. The performance record produces them. A blank amount is not treated as zero. A figure with no source row is not left in the draft. The advisor writes the outline and the interpretation before the draft runs.
Native configuration of the performance record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
The send is the signed text and no other text.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor checking that each claim and figure traces to a stored row.

incremental.description: Refresh figure identifier, amount, and source row identifier when the report layout changes, and drop a summary the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many figures have no source row. The high end assumes figure identifier, amount, and source row identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

steps.what: List the stored service text for this advisor
Explain the personal financial advisor's responsibilities
Explain the types of services to be provided
Sign the service explanation
File the signed service explanation
outputs: filed copy of signed service explanation v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists the stored service text. The advisor explains the personal financial advisor's responsibilities and the types of services to be provided. A later job files the signed explanation in {DOCS}. It does not speak to the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: The explanation depended on memory of the service list.
tasks.enabler_now: Service name and service text are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The explanation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides which services apply to this client.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the explanation, not on listing services.

reach.task: Rely only on the explanation the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor explains the services. A stored service text is not spoken by a job.

assumptions: Service name and service text are stored on the service record. The service record produces them. A blank service text is not invented. The advisor speaks the explanation.
Native configuration of the service record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor explaining the personal financial advisor's responsibilities.

incremental.description: Refresh service name and service text when the service layout changes, and drop an explanation the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many service texts are blank. The high end assumes service name and service text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

steps.what: List stored investment facts with no compatibility score
Investigate available investment opportunities in person
Determine compatibility with client financial plans
Sign the compatibility note
File the signed compatibility note
outputs: filed copy of signed compatibility note v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored investment facts and writes no compatibility score. The advisor investigates the opportunities and determines compatibility with the client financial plans. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not score the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fit was described without the stored facts beside the plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Opportunity identifier and stored fact are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The compatibility judgement stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether the opportunity fits the plan.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the investigation, not on listing facts.

reach.task: Hear only the note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S12] says credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk, and life and health insurance pricing is high-risk. This design does not score a client and does not price insurance.
Digest [S13] says the high-risk duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S15] says a score is an automated decision when the lender gives it a determining role. This design does not produce a score.
The executive digest says firms fall outside and sole traders do not. This design does not score a client either way.

assumptions: Opportunity identifier and stored fact are stored on the opportunity record. The opportunity record produces them. A blank fact is not a fit. The list is not a compatibility score.
Native configuration of the opportunity record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor investigating available investment opportunities.

incremental.description: Refresh opportunity identifier and stored fact when the opportunity layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stored facts are blank. The high end assumes opportunity identifier and stored fact are present. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed plan note can be filed the same day, and the advisor still decides the strategy.
